newsitem.title: USA: Texas claims could revoke Kaiser license - paper.
newsitem.headline: Texas claims could revoke Kaiser license - paper.

text.p: U.S. health-maintenance organization Kaiser Permanente could face a shutdown in Texas, the Los Angeles Times said on Thursday.

Texas Attorney General Dan Morales said earlier this week that the state had sufficient grounds to remove Kaiser's health maintenance organization license, the paper said. Texas authorities warn of a shut down due to alleged problems with the patient care quality and the company's finance.
Kaiser has won a court order blocking the release of a state report which is critical of the organization, it said.
Kaiser was quoted in the paper as saying Morales's statements were "absurd." Morales made the statements at a Texas Senate hearing Tuesday, the paper said.
